value.name: Lucia reveals changed will letter
value.description: Lucia tells Asha that Rosa has written a letter saying she changed her will and wanted Lucia to know directly.
evidence: "It says she has changed her will. It says she wanted me to know directly, in case anything happened to the paperwork."

value.name: Lucia explains Rosa's wishes
value.description: Lucia says Rosa trusted her to be kind to Daniel, expected him to be angry, and believed the house should be lived in rather than sold.
evidence: "It says she trusts me to be kind to Daniel about it. She says she knows he will be angry. She says the house should be lived in, and she does not believe Daniel will live in it."

value.name: Lucia admits she hid the letter
value.description: Lucia confesses that she has not shown the letter to anyone else.

value.name: Lucia explains delayed disclosure
value.description: Lucia says she is telling Asha now because she wants to handle the situation properly and avoid ambushing Daniel or being blamed for breaking the family.
evidence: "Because if Daniel sells the house and the codicil never turns up, the letter is just a sentimental object. I want to do this right. I don't want to ambush him. I don't want—"
"I don't want to be the one who broke this family. I want her to be the one who decided. Does that make sense."

value.name: Asha asserts involvement
value.description: Asha tells Lucia that the matter is no longer entirely Lucia's decision and asks to see the letter today.
evidence: "It makes sense," Asha said. "It is also not entirely your decision anymore."

value.name: Lucia arranges nighttime meeting
value.description: Lucia tells Asha to come that night after eight because Daniel will be gone.
evidence: "Come tonight. After eight. He'll be gone."

value.name: Asha reflects on family entanglement
value.description: After the call, Asha recognizes she is being drawn into the Serrano family's conflict and reminds herself to keep compassion separate from neutrality.
evidence: Asha closed her eyes for a moment after she hung up.
She was aware, with the clarity that her work required, that she was being drawn into the gravity of this family.
"Compassion was not neutrality, and the rule was the only thing that kept the two from collapsing into each other."

value.name: Asha returns to Serrano house
value.description: Asha goes back to the Serrano house later that evening to meet Lucia.
evidence: She went back to the Serrano house at half past eight.
